title: Byte For Byte
description: Customs paperwork is legally sensitive — a scanned certificate of origin that gets corrupted a single byte in storage is as good as lost. Prove what's stored in the database is exactly what was uploaded.
successCondition: Upload a customs document built from a known local file (or a fixed byte pattern you generate). Retrieve the stored content directly from Postgres — via `npx prisma studio` or a psql query selecting the content bytea column and exporting it (`\copy (select content from customs_documents where id = '<id>') to 'out.bin'` in psql, or Prisma Studio's binary viewer) — and confirm it is byte-for-byte identical to the original file you uploaded (same length, same hash/checksum).
hints: CustomsDocument.content is a Postgres bytea column (Bytes in Prisma) — it stores the raw file, not a path or a base64-reencoded copy that could silently mangle bytes.
Comparing a checksum (e.g. sha256 of both files) is more reliable than eyeballing bytes, especially for a binary PDF/JPEG/PNG.
